observations: Torah LM2 #105 is a four-line oral teaching with a single explicit bechina statement. The teaching connects only two concepts via bechina: 'לחדש דבר בתורה' (Torah innovation) and 'מדמה מלתא למלתא' (the analogical faculty applied to Torah). A package requires a cluster of concepts — a minimum of 3 or more bechina-connected nodes forming an independent thematic domain. With only two bechina-related concepts, no independent package can be formed. The broader conceptual pair (chiddush in Torah and koach hamedameh) is an extension of existing themes found in other LM2 Torahs (particularly the koach hamedameh / hirhurim complex), not a new standalone domain. The teaching's argument is almost entirely eitza-structured: koach hamedameh produces hirhurim; chiddush in Torah (being itself a form of medameh) repairs (via eitza) that damage. If the missing bechina edge is added ('לחדש איזה דבר בתורה' bechina 'מדמה מלתא למלתא'), that pair belongs to a 'כח המדמה / חידוש בתורה' package which could be proposed, but it would contain only 2 nodes — below the threshold for a meaningful new package. No new packages are proposed.
